claim: A vehicle (train, carriage, cart) is several sectors sharing one travel and one wire, its ceiling included, never one sector dressed in sprites. Only one member carries the voice.
evidence: The owner, 2026-11-24, of a train that was one sector dressed in sprites: 'we should be able to make it out of sectors if they will share same motion it will work ... more solid and not feeling like cut out of paper' (bloodmap/mechanism.py rigid_body docstring); its ceiling must move with it (projects/blood-city/references/phantom-terminus-design.md, 'As rebuilt'); blind readers had passed the sprite train.
use: Build with rigid_body and carry_fittings; read back with motion_sim.rigid_bodies and body_health.
